subject: Apex Consulting — Marketplace onboarding: MSA/DPA/SOW redlines
messages:
From: Michelle Turner <michelle.turner@apexconsulting.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com; vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@apexconsulting.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Apex Consulting — initial redlines for MSA/DPA/SOW for marketplace onboarding

Jonas / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team liked the connector approach and the marketplace placement makes sense for our GTM. Procurement asked us to send over the initial redlines for legal review so we can lock the onboarding timeline. Attached are the redlines for the MSA, a PDF summary of DPA comments, and a marked-up SOW (v2).

High level asks from our side:
- Narrow the liability cap carveout for customer data to be reciprocal and tied to gross negligence.
- Clarify data deletion timeline in the DPA (we'd prefer 45 days after contract termination).
- Add a milestone-based acceptance criteria to the SOW (3 checkpoints with sign-off).

We're aiming to get the commercial terms signed by 4/15 to hit a late-Apr go-live. Can you confirm who from Redwood will take the lead on legal redlines and procurement coordination?

Attachments: Apex_MSA_Redlines.docx, Apex_DPA_comments.pdf, Apex_SOW_v2_markedup.docx

Best,

Michelle Turner
Head of Partnerships | Apex Consulting

+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Apex Consulting — initial redlines for MSA/DPA/SOW for marketplace onboarding

Jonas / team — taking point. Summary of our plan below: 

1) MSA: I'll do a line-by-line on Apex_MSA_Redlines.docx and propose language that keeps our indemnity and data liability positions but offers targeted reciprocity for third-party claims tied to customer data. Expect a redline by Fri 4/2 5pm PST.

2) DPA: I agree the deletion window is negotiable; propose 30 days standard with a clause for escalated requests to 45 days for strategic partners (subject to additional security attestations). Will add the clause and rationale in Apex_DPA_comments.pdf.

3) SOW: Kimberly, please define the milestone acceptance gates and whether revenue recognition or payment schedule needs to change if acceptance is spaced across 3 checkpoints.

For procurement: Kimberly, can you confirm if Redwood needs a PO or a signed DocuSign envelope to match Apex's procurement workflow? Michelle, is Apex OK with DocuSign for the final signoff?

Attaching a quick checklist: [Attachment: Redwood_Onboard_Checklist.pdf] (internal).

Thanks — I'll circulate our redlines and call out any clauses that need legal escalation.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0255

From: Michelle Turner <michelle.turner@apexconsulting.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@apexconsulting.com, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@apexconsulting.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Apex Consulting — initial redlines for MSA/DPA/SOW for marketplace onboarding

Vanessa — thanks for the quick plan. A couple clarifications from procurement: 
- DocuSign is fine for Apex.
- The 45 day deletion request would be acceptable if Redwood can provide a SOC2 Type II report and a weekly access log around the time of transfer. Procurement will need that in writing.

Also, Derek from our legal ops is including a short reconciliation table (attached) that maps our redline sections to your suggested clause numbers; this should speed review.

Attachments: Apex_Reconciliation_Table.xlsx

Michelle

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michelle Turner <michelle.turner@apexconsulting.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Apex Consulting — initial redlines for MSA/DPA/SOW for marketplace onboarding

Michelle — quick procurement / SOW update.

1) Acceptance milestones: We're proposing the three checkpoints as: (A) Integration smoke test (Dev sandbox) — sign-off by Apex dev lead; (B) Staging performance validation (latency/cost baselines) — joint sign-off; (C) Production readiness checklist + go/no-go call. Each milestone triggers 33% of the implementation fee.

2) PO / Signature workflow: Redwood is fine with DocuSign; we do not require a separate PO for marketplace partners under $50k. If total contracted value > $50k, we'll need a PO. Please confirm expected total for SOW.

3) Security evidence: Vanessa, legal will add the SOC2 paragraph and specify the logs/proof needed. Michelle — if procurement can provide the SOC2 and confirm weekly logs at signing, we'll accept the 45-day deletion window as an exception for this partner.

Next steps: Vanessa to send formal redline documents; Jonas to coordinate a short call next week if Apex wants to walk through the redlines live. Once DocuSign is ready we'll route to both teams.

Thanks — Kim
